sketches.mechanism: An uninhabited algebraic data type with an exhaustive empty case can define a function to any type because no value can ever call it.
sketches.resonance: The impossible is allowed to promise everything precisely because it can never arrive.

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference to a class instance does not retain it and is automatically set to nil when the last strong reference leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: What is held without keeping it alive vanishes as soon as the world stops holding it for you.

sketches.mechanism: The pin operator matches against an existing binding instead of rebinding it, causing a match failure when the later value contradicts the first.
sketches.resonance: A first truth, once pinned, cannot be edited by a later refusal.
